newsitem.title: FINLAND: MERITA SEES FINNISH CORPORATE BOND BONANZA IN 1998.
newsitem.headline: MERITA SEES FINNISH CORPORATE BOND BONANZA IN 1998.

text.p: There is likely to be a wave of Finnish corporate bond issues in 1998, Harri Hollmen, head of Merita Oy's investment banking arm said on Thursday.
The issues would come as Finnish corporations start securitising their debt portfolios once there is a clear view of the success of Economic and Monetary Union, he told a seminar.
"There will be a bond bonanza as companies will begin to restructure their markka loans into Eurobonds," Hollmen said.
He said there are currently more than 50 Finnish companies that could qualify as issuers of corporate bonds.
